scripts.dev:emu: tsx scripts/build-rules.ts --uid owner-test-uid && tsx scripts/emu.ts "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && vite --mode emulator"
scripts.dev:desktop-emu: tsx scripts/build-rules.ts --uid owner-test-uid && tsx scripts/emu.ts "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && vite --mode desktop-emu"
scripts.test:emu: tsx scripts/build-rules.ts --uid owner-test-uid && tsx scripts/emu.ts "vitest run --project emulator"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && tsx scripts/build-rules.ts && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.desktop:emu: tsx scripts/build-rules.ts --uid owner-test-uid && tsx scripts/emu.ts "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && tsx scripts/desktop-run.ts --emu"
scripts.desktop:smoke: tsx scripts/build-rules.ts --uid owner-test-uid && tsx scripts/emu.ts "tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts && tsx scripts/desktop-run.ts --smoke"
